rubric.keep: Explanations, evidence, useful examples, comparisons, teaching stories, meaningful opinions and conclusions.
rubric.context: Mixed promotion and information, satirical detours, uncertain boundaries or transitions.
rubric.skip: Clear channel housekeeping, pure promotional call to action or empty farewell.
rubric.unknown: Non-speech, missing captions or unreviewed visual content.

limitations: One agent review; no independent human labels or full visual review.
All ten selected videos contain substantial topic-relevant material, so rejection of wholly low-value videos is not tested.
Seven videos are from Fireship; creator/style balance is limited.
Technical and news claims are assessed for relevance, not independently fact-checked.
